meta.title: Certificate Expiry Tracking: refused for a user without the MDM / Master Data Team role
gaps: Certificate Expiry Tracking is not represented by any catalog step.
Signing in as separate users with and without the MDM / Master Data Team role is not supported.
Verifying the tenant is on Enterprise and checking its RBAC configuration is not supported.
Attempting staged reminders and auto-block, and comparing refusal or availability between the two roles, is not supported.
the plan has no assertion step — nothing the case checks can be observed
warnings: cannot test this case yet — the plan has no assertion step — nothing the case checks can be observed

args.need: sign in as a user without the MDM / Master Data Team role and as an MDM / Master Data Team user on the Enterprise tenant, open Certificate Expiry Tracking, attempt staged reminders and auto-block, and record whether the action is refused or unavailable for the first user and available for the second

steps.note: The catalog cannot reach this feature, switch user roles, verify the tenant plan, or observe the role-dependent permission outcome.
